title: State Drug Alert: CDSCO Flags 288 Samples Including Thyrox, Mounjaro as NSQ in September
summary: New Delhi: Continuing its nationwide surveillance of drug quality, the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) has flagged 288 drug, cosmetic, medical device and surgical product samples...
